pages.title: A rental office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday morning at a car rental office in Phoenix. The sun is hot and the sky is blue. Noah walks in with a small bag. Wade stands behind the desk. Cars wait outside in the parking lot. Wade says hello.
“Hello, Noah! Do you want to rent a car?” says Wade. “Yes, I’d like a small car for three days.” says Noah. “No problem. It’s fifty dollars per day.” says Wade.
